name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into the world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science, he initially worked in the tech industry, developing software for various applications. A chance encounter with a former racing engineer sparked his interest in the complex data systems that underpin modern racing. He saw an opportunity to combine his technical skills with his newfound passion. 

Joining Hitech GP was a pivotal moment. Park's approach to IT systems management is rooted in reliability and efficiency. He believes in building robust infrastructure that can withstand the demands of a high-pressure environment. Known for his meticulousness and problem-solving abilities, Park is a key asset to the team. His dedication to ensuring seamless data flow and secure communication is what sets him apart, allowing the team to make informed decisions quickly.
